scope.line: Small ask. Teeny. Barely a requirement.

scope.name: LEO
scope.line: What if it also did… everything?

host_replies.record: Fine. Balanced. Debits equal credits equal debits equal credits equal—
host_replies.blocker: Your question has been forwarded to the Change Advisory Board. Expected response: after the heat death of the universe.
host_replies.invite: I'm great! Let's sync on how great I am. I've sent you an invite. It's recurring. Forever. Accept?
host_replies.scope: Fine! Just one tiny thing. And another. And— everything. I want everything. Small ask.

host_soon: See you soon. Very soon. Your ticket is almost ready.

Sleeper.role: Platform Team · asleep, technically on call

a.text: zZz… the dashboards are green… the dashboards are always green… zZz…
replies: Wake up. Production is on fire.

wake.text: Production has been on fire since the reorg. I'm conserving energy for the postmortem. Someone has to look rested in the screenshot.

spirit.text: I'm on call in spirit. My body is Out Of Office. We're in different time zones, me and my body.

tuck.text: …tell my manager I was 'heads-down'… that's not a lie… my head is down…

pager.text: The pager is set to 'vibrate'. It's under them. It has been vibrating since 4 PM. They call it 'the massage'.

a.text: Don't look at me. I'm on a different incident.
replies: Help me fight the corrupted records.

which.text: INC-000. It's the incident about having too many incidents. We scheduled a meeting to triage the meetings. Then the meeting got its own incident number.

observer.text: I can add you as an Observer. Observers get every notification and none of the authority. It's like management, but honest.

help.text: I'd love to, but my OKR is 'tickets closed', not 'monsters killed'. File a ticket and I'll close it as Duplicate. Great for my numbers.

watch.text: Watching is a contribution. I'm 'maintaining situational awareness'. It's on my self-review. Under 'Leadership'.

again.text: Still not my incident. Still watching, though. Strong work on the one you're doing alone.

Manager.role: Engineering Manager · on a call about the call

a.text: Yes, someone's on it. No, I don't know who. — Oh! You! You're on it?

eta.text: Amazing. I'll tell leadership 'we' are on it. Quick one: can you give me an ETA for the ETA? I need a number to say confidently.

deck.text: Love it. I'll put 'two minutes' in the deck to show ambition. If it slips, that's a growth opportunity. For you.

aligned.text: I'll write 'aligned on next steps'. That sentence has never been wrong. It has never been anything.

managing.text: Managing expectations. Mostly upward. Leadership expects production to be fixed, and I expect to be thanked for it.

growth.text: Unbelievable growth, yes. Put that in your self-review. In the 'what your manager did' box. Use full sentences.

help.text: I am helping. I've renamed the Slack channel twice. Morale is up eleven percent. I measured it. With a poll. That I answered.

home.text: Of course! Right after this. And the retro. And the retro about the retro. We're a family here, and family doesn't leave at 5.

again.text: Back so soon? Is it fixed? No? Then why are you talking to me? I'm in a very important tab.

a.text: Ticket open since 2019. Today's the day. Probably.

chain.text: Nothing's wrong with it. It's waiting on a part. The part is waiting on a PO. The PO is waiting on budget. Budget is waiting on Q3. Q3 is waiting on the microwave.

word.text: Don't say that word near it. Last time someone said 'circular dependency' it sparked and three VPs got promoted.

capex.text: A new one is CapEx. Fixing the old one is OpEx. I've spent four years of OpEx avoiding sixty dollars of CapEx. The spreadsheet says I'm winning.

hand.text: Sure. Hold this wire. No, not that one— … you felt that, right? Good. That means it works. Somewhere.

Standup.role: Feature Team · still in the 9:00 standup

a.text: Yesterday: meetings. Today: meetings. Blockers: meetings.

alone.text: The standup. Everyone dropped off at 9:15. I don't know how to end it. Nobody ever taught me how to end it.

free.text: …that's… it… from me. — Oh no. Oh, I'm free. What do I do with my hands? Who do I report my feelings to?

velocity.text: Velocity is up 400 percent since I started counting each sentence as a story point. This one is a three.

blockers.text: You, physically. Also Legal, Procurement, the VPN, the concept of Friday, and a calendar invite titled 'Quick Chat (2h)'.

a.text: Is it normal to be on call on day one?

normal.text: Cool cool cool. They also gave me production access, a pager, and the root password on a sticky note. Is that also normal?

loadbearing.text: I can't. It's load-bearing. The VPN stops working without it. IT said it's 'temporarily permanent'.

box.text: I can't run, I'm carrying the 'Culture' box. It's mostly lanyards. And one kombucha. The kombucha is the culture.

swag.text: Four hundred t-shirts that say DISRUPT. They disrupted the budget for raises to print them. I got a small. I'm a large. That's also culture.

a.text: I'm working from home. This is home now.

live.text: Define 'live'. I have a sofa, a microwave I'm not allowed to use, and a standing desk I sit at. My commute is four metres. Return-to-office was a huge success.

certificate.text: Sad? I hit one hundred percent badge-in compliance. HR sent me a certificate. I sleep under it. It's warmer than it looks.

a.text: It said one minute. That was forty minutes ago.

burrito.text: A burrito. Or it was. It's in a superposition now. Facilities marked it 'pending'. Like my promotion.

sunk.text: And walk away from forty minutes of sunk cost? That's not how we do things here. Here we double down. Ask the roadmap.

escalate.text: I escalated it. It came back assigned to me, as a Blocker. Now I'm blocking my own burrito.

denial.text: Don't. I know. I'm in the denial stage. Let me have this. It's the only thing here with a status light that's honest.

a.text: We're like a family here. A family with KPIs.

family.text: The kind you can't leave, where holidays are optional, and the parent is a quarterly earnings call.

hiring.text: Always! We need a senior engineer with ten years in a framework released last spring. Compensation: exposure. To production.

ownership.text: We prefer 'high-ownership culture'. You own everything. Except equity.

sign.text: You already did. Page 41 of the laptop policy. Welcome back. You never left.

pay.text: Extremely competitive. Competitive with what, we can't legally disclose. But we have a ping-pong table. Nobody's allowed to use it during business hours, which are all hours.
